title: remember answer
description: The memory tool remember's answer (SB-P3-09): a new memory, always a draft, landing in the caller's own scope unless the call names one. No memory's words, only where it is and what changed. Listed and answered only with memory.tools on (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.
